connector.name: IBAN Validation MCP
connector.registryDescription: Validate IBANs in 111 countries; bank directory checks for DE, AT, BE, FR, LU, NL, PT and ES.
connector.summary: Hosted at iban-test.eu over streamable HTTP. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace eu.iban-test.www. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
